note: Speaking practice for B1/B2 exams in three stages per topic. Stage 1 is a one-minute long turn about a photo, as in Part 2 of the Cambridge B1 Preliminary and B2 First speaking tests. Stage 2 is a talk from a topic card: one minute to make notes, then up to two minutes of speaking, as in IELTS Speaking Part 2. Stage 3 is a discussion of a wider question, as in IELTS Part 3 or the last part of the Cambridge tests. The topics and photos were written for this site; they are not taken from a real exam paper.

stages.label: 1 · The photo
stages.hint: Talk about the photo for one minute. Say who you can see, where they are and what they are doing. If you are not sure, guess: “They might be …”, “It looks like …”.

stages.label: 2 · The talk
stages.hint: Read the topic card and take one minute to make notes. Then start the timer and talk for up to two minutes. Cover every point on the card.

stages.label: 3 · Discussion
stages.hint: In the exam the examiner or your partner asks you about this. Give your opinion, a reason and an example. Then say what someone who disagrees might think.

prompts.title: Photo 1: Working together
beschreibung: What can you see in the photo? Where are the people and what are they doing?
What is the atmosphere like? How can you tell?

kurzvortrag.topic: Describe a time when you helped someone without being paid. You should say:
points: and explain how you felt about it afterwards.

prompts.diskussion: Should schools make volunteering compulsory for teenagers, or does it stop being volunteering then?

prompts.title: Photo 2: Health and everyday life
beschreibung: Who can you see in the photo, and what situation are they in?
How do most people feel in a situation like this?

kurzvortrag.topic: Describe a healthy habit you have, or would like to have. You should say:
points: when you started it, or why you haven't started yet
and explain why it is good for you.

prompts.diskussion: Should unhealthy food and drinks cost more because of extra taxes, or should people decide for themselves what they eat?

prompts.title: Photo 3: Building homes
beschreibung: What is happening in the photo? What materials can you see?
What kind of place do you think this photo was taken in?

kurzvortrag.topic: Describe a place where you would like to live in the future. You should say:
points: what kind of home you would like there
and explain why you would prefer it to where you live now.

prompts.diskussion: Should towns build more affordable homes, even if it means losing parks and green spaces?

prompts.title: Photo 4: Life on screen
beschreibung: What can you see? Where do you think this person is?
How many hours a day do you think people spend in front of a screen?

kurzvortrag.topic: Describe a website or an app that you use a lot. You should say:
points: and explain how your life would be different without it.

prompts.diskussion: Should children under 16 be allowed to use social media?

prompts.title: Photo 5: Learning for life
beschreibung: What can you see in the photo? What is the person probably doing?
In your opinion, when do people learn best?

kurzvortrag.topic: Describe your experience of learning English. You should say:
points: and explain what advice you would give to someone who is just starting.

prompts.diskussion: Is it better to learn a language in a class, or just by using it every day with people who speak it?

prompts.title: Photo 6: Talking to each other
beschreibung: Who is talking to whom, and what might they be talking about?
How are the people behaving? Who is listening and who is talking?

kurzvortrag.topic: Describe a time when you were new somewhere, for example in a town, a job or a school. You should say:
points: what was difficult at the beginning
and explain what helped you to feel at home.

prompts.diskussion: What is the best way for a town to help newcomers feel welcome?
